title: BGV Candidate Data Fetch API enforces 403 in real-time on each request — a request made one day before lapse succeeds and a request made one day after lapse is blocked
preconditions: BGV Verification Partner API credentials are available and valid
A candidate exists with BGV status = Completed, with a BGV completion date that can be controlled or simulated to be exactly at the boundary (completion date + configured days = today or tomorrow)
The BGV Candidate Data Fetch API endpoint and authentication mechanism are documented and accessible for testing
Test environment supports date manipulation or a candidate with a precisely known completion date is available

test_data.value: Exactly 30 days before today (today = completion date + 30, so window expires today)
Exactly 31 days before today (current date > completion date + 30)

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Flows > Onboarding > Advanced Settings > BGV Settings.
steps.expected: The BGV Settings section is visible.

steps.action: Check the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox.
steps.expected: Checkbox becomes checked. The adjacent numeric input becomes editable.

steps.action: Clear the numeric input field and enter '30'.
steps.expected: The numeric input displays '30' with no inline validation error.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: Settings are saved successfully. A success notification appears.

steps.action: Using an API client, send a request to the BGV Candidate Data Fetch API for the candidate whose BGV completion date is exactly 30 days ago (current date = completion date + 30, i.e., the window boundary — NOT yet lapsed if the condition is strictly 'current date > completion date + configured days').
steps.expected: The API responds with HTTP 200 OK and normal candidate data. The 403 is NOT triggered because the condition 'current date > completion date + 30' is not yet true (current date equals, not exceeds, the boundary).

steps.action: Using an API client, send a request to the BGV Candidate Data Fetch API for the candidate whose BGV completion date is exactly 31 days ago (current date > completion date + 30 — window has lapsed).
steps.expected: The API responds with HTTP 403 Forbidden and response body: {"error": "Verification has been completed; data access has been revoked."}. The 403 is enforced because the condition 'current date > completion date + 30' is true.

steps.action: Send a second request immediately to the same lapsed candidate's API endpoint without any configuration change.
steps.expected: The API again responds with HTTP 403 Forbidden with the same error body — confirming real-time enforcement on each individual API request, not a cached or one-time evaluation.

expected_result: The API enforces the 403 in real-time on each request: a candidate at exactly the boundary (current date = completion date + configured days) is still accessible, while a candidate one day past the boundary (current date > completion date + configured days) is blocked with 403 on every request.
assertions_summary: Candidate at exactly the boundary day (current date = completion date + days) returns HTTP 200
Candidate one day past the boundary (current date > completion date + days) returns HTTP 403
403 is returned on every subsequent request to the lapsed candidate — real-time enforcement confirmed
Response body for 403 matches exactly: {"error": "Verification has been completed; data access has been revoked."}
review_reason: The boundary condition depends on whether 'current date > completion date + configured days' is evaluated as strictly greater than (exclusive) or greater than or equal to (inclusive). The exact boundary behavior (same day = allowed or blocked) must be confirmed against the implementation. Test data for the boundary day candidate may require date manipulation in the test environment.

title: Access evaluation uses calendar date comparison only and is not affected by time-of-day
preconditions: Logged-in user has Admin or Onboarding Admin role with access to Onboarding Settings
Enable BGV toggle is ON in Advanced Settings > BGV Settings
At least one candidate exists with BGV status = Completed and BGV completion date exactly N days ago where N equals the configured threshold (e.g., completed exactly 30 days ago when threshold is 30)

test_data.value: Exactly 30 calendar days before today's date

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Flows > Onboarding > Advanced Settings.
steps.expected: Advanced Settings page loads successfully.

steps.action: Check the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox and set the numeric input to 30. Click Save.
steps.expected: Settings saved successfully.

steps.action: Identify the test candidate whose BGV completion date is exactly 30 calendar days before today. Verify the BGV partner access state for this candidate.
steps.expected: The candidate's access state is evaluated using date-only comparison (not timestamp). Since current date equals BGV completion date + 30 days (not strictly greater than), the candidate should still have active access (access active: current date ≤ BGV completion date + configured days). Access is NOT revoked on the exact boundary day.

expected_result: A candidate whose BGV was completed exactly 30 days ago (matching the threshold exactly) retains access because the evaluation condition is 'current date > completion date + days' (strictly greater than), and the date comparison is calendar-date only with no timestamp dependency.
assertions_summary: Access is active when current date equals BGV completion date + configured days (boundary: not strictly greater than)
Evaluation uses calendar date only, not timestamp
review_reason: Exact boundary behavior (strictly greater than vs. greater than or equal) and date-only comparison logic requires backend/API-level verification or a precisely timed test execution.
